task: Create encrypted pastes to reopen on this computer

x-display.title: Save encrypted text pastes
x-display.summary: Create encrypted text pastes and reopen them in your browser on this computer.
x-display.description: Use the editor for text you want to keep behind its own paste link. This package starts a local PrivateBin instance; it is not a public paste-sharing site. The link contains the information needed to open the paste again.

packaging_note: Adapted the Dokploy route to a loopback page. Keep encrypted pastes in a named volume.
licence: PrivateBin uses Zlib and the component licences in its LICENSE.md. Dokploy template MIT.

access.why: The service uses a container network to serve its local address.

known_issues: Links open on this computer. Keep the full link, including the key after the hash, to decrypt a saved paste.
